🧩 Core stack
Jekyll
Static site generator that turns your Markdown + templates into a full website.
Markdown
Used for writing stories, updates, and portfolio content.
**HTML + CSS
Custom layouts and styling for your site (no heavy framework).
🧠 Content management
Decap CMS
Provides the /admin panel so you can add/edit content without coding.
🚀 Hosting & deployment
Netlify
Builds the site automatically from your repo
Hosts it with HTTPS
Handles forms and identity (login for CMS)
GitHub
Stores your code and content; every push triggers a deploy.
🌐 Domain & DNS
GoDaddy
Your domain is registered here and pointed to Netlify via DNS.
⚙️ Workflow (how it all connects)
You write/edit content in Decap CMS or locally.
Changes go to GitHub.
Netlify builds the site using Jekyll.
The static site is served on your domain.
🧭 In one sentence

A Jekyll-based static site with Markdown content, managed via Decap CMS, deployed automatically from GitHub to Netlify, and served on your GoDaddy domain.
